A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Crotok]] '''individual''' [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Interceptor''-class Arakyd Helix]] named ''[[Kizbon's Box]]'' on a route toward the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Darknon Station]]. En route, he was [[Ambush near Darknon Station|ambushed]] while near a [[Ion storm/Legends|magnetic storm]], which his attackers had used for cover. The group attacking him were [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who had been provided with the details of the ''Box's'' route by [[Sahr]], a [[Gender/Legends|women]] who knew the pilot but now accompanied the pirates. When confronted by the pirates, who believed the ''Box'' to be unarmed, the pilot surprised them by opening fire with concealed weaponry destroying first a vessel named ''[[Trust Me]]'' and then another named [[Profit (pirate ship)|''Profit'']] which was piloted by an individual named [[Druug]]. The final ship, the ''[[Pillage]]'' was crewed by a pirate named [[Larken]], and Sahr, both of whom the pilot knew by name. As they tried to escape the ''Box'' caught up with them and [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] the ''Pillage'', calling the crew by name and aiming the ''Box's'' weaponry at them.<ref name="ABGTAS">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot first appeared in [[1995]] the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. The pilot appeared in one of these, titled "''Kizbon's Box''" which gave no information as to what era it was set in and also didn't mention the pilots name, gender or species.
